# Cardiac Implantable Electronic Device (CIED) Pre-Op Prophylaxis Antibiotics

# Pre-procedure IV prophylaxis antibiotic recommendations:

# Preferred prophylaxis:

For patients weight less than 120 kg:
Cefazolin 2 gm IV over 30 minutes beginning 60 minutes before incision($) [R]
For patients weight equal to or greater than 120kg:
Cefazolin 3 GM IV over 30 minutes beginning 60 minutes before incision ($) [R]

# Alternative in patients with beta lactam allergy:

Vancomycin 15mg/kg IV beginning 120 minutes before incision ($) [R]

# Recommended for MRSA Positive Patients: Decolonization AND Pre-op Antibiotics

# Decolonization for MRSA positive:

Mupirocin Ointment apply topical to each nares bid for 5 days PRIOR TO PROCEDURE (ideally) ($) [M]

# Preferred prophylaxis for MRSA positive:

For patients weight less than 120 kg:
Cefazolin 2 gm IV over 30 minutes beginning 60 minutes before incision ($) [R] < AND > Vancomycin 15 MG/KG IV beginning 120 minutes before incision ($) [R]
For patients weight equal to or greater than 120 kg:
Cefazolin 3 gm IV over 30 minutes beginning 60 minutes before incision ($) [R] < AND > Vancomycin 15 MG/KG IV beginning 120 minutes before incision ($) [R]

# References:

Bratzler DW, et al.  Clinical practice guidelines for antimicrobial prophylaxis
in surgery, Am J Health-Syst Pharm. 2013 vol 70 pages 195-283
